verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a hosted calculation API that determines rates from product type, customer location and business location, so rate logic lives on the vendor side and a redeploy is implied to be unnecessary. One beta user also confirms Stripe handles VAT determination automatically. However, nothing in the evidence states that rate and rule changes are pushed automatically or announced with effective dates. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic rate/rule updates across jurisdictions, a changelog or notices showing when changes take effect, any statement that no redeploy is required, independent corroboration of update timeliness.
